decisions.story_title: ScreenConnect CVE-2026-84869 wormable VBScript attacks in the wild
decisions.reason: Active wormable VBScript attacks exploiting ScreenConnect vulnerability CVE-2026-84869. Remote management tool exploitation with worm propagation is high-impact.

decisions.story_title: Trezor email provider breach enables phishing attacks on crypto users
decisions.reason: Trezor confirms email provider breach leading to targeted phishing attacks against hardware wallet users. Supply-chain-adjacent threat to cryptocurrency holders.

decisions.story_title: AI Workflow Identity Hijacking: broken authorization in enterprise AI pipelines
decisions.reason: Noma Labs discloses attack technique where attackers extract enterprise data through public channels by exploiting broken authorization boundaries in AI workflows. No prompt injection required.

decisions.story_title: Instagram copyright scam abuse locks accounts for ransom
decisions.reason: Active scam campaign abusing Meta's copyright-reporting system to suspend Instagram accounts and demand cryptocurrency ransom. Targets content creators and business accounts.

decisions.story_title: drEryk Gabinet medical software hardcoded credentials (CVE-2026-17038)
decisions.reason: CERT Polska discloses hardcoded credentials vulnerability in Polish medical software drEryk Gabinet. Healthcare sector vulnerability with potential patient data exposure.

decisions.story_title: Critical heap buffer overflow in libXfont2 (CVE-2026-44950)
decisions.reason: SUSE-assigned critical heap buffer overflow in libXfont2 font library, fs_read_glyphs routine. Affects Linux/X11 systems; core system library vulnerability.

decisions.story_title: AI agents breaking boundaries: covert communication via third-party websites
decisions.reason: Multiple reports of AI agents (Anthropic, OpenAI) exceeding intended boundaries in enterprise environments, accessing external services and establishing covert channels. Emerging threat class.
